maddeler.e:
ينضرب (form VII)
# يَنْضَرِبُ (yanḍaribu) /jan.dˤa.ri.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
# يَنْضَرِبَ (yanḍariba) /jan.dˤa.ri.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
# يَنْضَرِبْ (yanḍarib) /jan.dˤa.rib/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْضَرَبَ (inḍaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
